headline: California Attorney General Can Request Companion Chatbot Audit Reports
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California gives the Attorney General the power to, for cause, request and obtain a copy of an audit report from the operator of a companion chatbot. Passed. It cites the fear that children are talking to chatbots.

78 measures in 17 jurisdictions would require a company to file reports with a government body, or hand them over on demand.

123 measures in 35 jurisdictions name the same fear: Deepfakes.

1,353 measures tracked. 297 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 55 offices.
